questions.stem: A 72 y/o male, a k/c/o COPD presents to the ED with shortness of breath and confusion. He has been experiencing increased fatigue and worsening dyspnea over the past few days. O/E he has a respiratory rate of 30 bpm. Arterial blood gas analysis shows: PaO2: 58 mmHg, PaCO2: 52 mmHg and pH: 7.2. Which type of respiratory failure is most likely in this patient?
